objective: Fix the cache-expiration bug in src/cache.js: ttl is given in SECONDS but the expiry check compares it against elapsed MILLISECONDS, so entries expire ~1000x too early. An entry must expire strictly after ttl seconds (at exactly ttl seconds it is still valid).
criteria: entry with ttl 5 still present after 2000ms and gone after 6000ms; boundary at exactly 5000ms still valid; every test under tests/ passes
